axes_note: Three axes only (sources.json categories[politics]._note): (1) POLICY/REGULATION, (2) AI IN ELECTIONS & PUBLIC OPINION, (3) AI GEOPOLITICS. No AI-less general politics (delete AI from the headline -> if it still stands, drop). Non-partisan: report what was decided/filed/published, attribute contested claims to the named party, no horse-race/polling commentary. Prefer the primary document (bill text, ruling, agency release); primary doc + news report about it = ONE story. Follow-ups on published stories count only with a NEW ruling/filing/bill/order/official release.

plan_notes: RECENCY: lead with outlet RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds (rss_feeds_first) and filter by pubDate within the 72h window (since 2026-10-12T22:00Z). WebSearch site: queries tend to return evergreen pages - use WebSearch only to fill gaps, and verify every published time on the article page itself.
OUTPUT: write candidates under the key "items" (NOT "candidates").

SCOPE: follow sources.json categories[politics]._note - three axes only: (1) policy/regulation, (2) AI in elections & public opinion, (3) AI geopolitics. No AI-less general politics; if deleting AI from the headline leaves a standing story, drop it. Aim for spread across all three axes and across regions (US federal/state, EU, UK, Korea, China/Asia).

NEUTRALITY: non-partisan; report what was decided/filed/published; attribute contested claims to the named party; no horse-race or polling commentary. Prefer primary documents (bill text, ruling, agency release); primary doc and news report about it are ONE story.

DEDUP: do not resubmit anything in recently_published_do_not_resubmit. Follow-ups qualify only with a NEW ruling, filing, bill, executive order or official release (e.g. the EO 14409 framework text itself if released, a court order in the Character.AI bankruptcy, a formal EU AI Office decision). Commentary/analysis/reactions on published events are dropped.
Paywalled/crawler-blocked majors (reuters, bloomberg, ft, wsj, nytimes, economist, foreignpolicy) are excluded - find the same decision on an allowed outlet or the primary source.
